label: dam-probe-p2
_why: ENGINE PROBE of the hydro-dam megaprojects (ROADMAP step 6, BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.90, user-ruled 2026-09-26: 'Go on with the tests. Full 100 years n=1 after all the probes you need'). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams-probe.json {kind: config}: the canon (canon-b164-trade) + building_required_construction {building_power_plant: 1600} + dams {enabled, the FINAL 159-project table with researched anchor provinces} + dams.probe {the three class technologies granted at the start to GBR FRA USA RUS PRU AUS SWE SAR SWI TUR; surveys 2 months; stage cost x0.05}. The probe settings exist ONLY to make the mechanism fire inside three years; nothing economic is read from this run. P2 over p1 (20260926_145556, FINDINGS to follow): the AI runs one dam survey at a time (p1: five at once drove Britain into bureaucratic deficit and it cancelled all of them), logs carry the country NAME (no tag function exists) and its produced/used bureaucracy, per-stage technology classes, and a probe-only diagnostic: at each survey completion the anchor state logs can_construct_building for stage 1, and every second project is force-started with start_building_construction.

_questions.Q1: Is stage 1 constructible once surveyed (probe_can_build yes)?
_questions.Q2: Do force-started stages build to completion and fire on_building_built (built / complete lines, the arable and trait effects)?
_questions.Q3: Does the government AI queue any unforced stage by 1840?
_questions.Q4: Do the bureaucracy log lines resolve, and does the one-survey-at-a-time rule stop the cancellation cascade?

_predictions.Q1: yes wherever the surveyor chain owns the anchor
_predictions.Q2: yes, ~20 weeks at the probe cost x0.05
_predictions.Q3: uncertain - p1 showed no stage in any queue; governments in 1836-39 build little

_cost: 1 run x 1836.1.1 -> 1840.1.1, about 6 minutes of play plus the build and load.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
